cases.task: Using input.md, create a TARGET (TO-BE) map for the internal design-review request. Include a customer journey map, service blueprint, and experience-process view in one deliverable. Save a standalone HTML artifact as output/map.html and editable source JSON as output/map.json. Do not assume missing requirements; label unresolved information and affected paths explicitly.

Save a standalone HTML artifact as output/map.html and editable source JSON as output/map.json. Preserve source labels and distinguish documented rules from observed behavior.
